messages:
tiffany: hey team — on the Acme POC the agent keeps returning JSON blobs that break our parser. looks like HTML entities <div> etc. are escaped inside string fields and the strict json_mode parser fails. customer is blocked for demo later today :grimacing:
jamal: can you paste the raw response (not prettified) and the request payload you sent?
tiffany: sure, raw response below (redacted). note: root call used json_mode: \"strict\" and schema validation.
```
{"id":"resp_123","body":"{\"summary\":\"Patient notes: <div>seen for cough</div>\",\"code\":200}EXTRA_TEXT"}
```
anya: whoa — there's actually literal EXTRA_TEXT after the JSON closing brace. that will 100% break strict parsing. looks like the model appended commentary after finishing the JSON.
jamal: 2 distinct problems: 1) model appended freeform text after the JSON (finish reason / stop token mismatch) 2) string fields contain HTML entities which some parsers don't unescape automatically. both together cause parse errors.
devin: which SDK and call pattern? streaming? functions?
tiffany: JS SDK, chat.completions, streaming disabled, function_call disabled. payload: ```json
{"model":"open-rlm-1","json_mode":"strict","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"},"code":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["summary","code"]},"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize notes"}]}
```
jamal: quick workaround for demo: 1) switch json_mode to \"relaxed\" which tolerates trailing text and tries to extract the first JSON object, OR 2) run a pre-parse cleanup that strips trailing non-json after the first matching brace pair and HTML-unescape entities before JSON.parse.
anya: for the long term we should: a) make the server-side json-mode preprocessor unescape HTML entities in string tokens before handing to the strict parser, b) add a tolerant extraction path for trailing content and log when it happens, and c) include a guardrail in the Console that surfaces \"model returned trailing text\" as a warning.
security-bot: reminder — do NOT paste live PHI/PII. redact any patient identifiers.
tiffany: thanks — everything above is redacted.
devin: infra note: if you toggle to relaxed mode for prod traffic, watch unit-cost — relaxed does more postprocessing. also add a short-term rate-limit check if the POC ramps up request retries. infra-bot: flagged rate-limit dashboard for that customer as requested.
jamal: I'll prepare a small patch: unescape HTML entities in the pre-JSON tokenizer and attempt to extract the first balanced JSON object. can ship as a minor patch tomorrow and roll out to hosted. in the meantime, sales can propose the relaxed-mode workaround to Acme to unblock demo.
tiffany: perfect. i'll tell them the workaround + ETA for the hosted fix. can we get a short note for the customer about mitigations (one-paragraph)?
jamal: yes — i'll draft: \"Temporary workaround: set json_mode=\\\"relaxed\\\" or run a lightweight cleanup that strips trailing text and unescapes HTML entities before parsing. Permanent fix: we will add server-side unescape + tolerant extraction in next minor release (ETA: 72 hours).\"
anya: add instrumented logs so we can count occurrences — want to know if this is model/temperature dependent.
iffany: (typo) tiffany: noted, logging requested.
security-bot: re-check: if you unescape HTML make sure we don't inadvertently render into a downstream viewer without sanitization. Security will approve the change with that caveat.
jamal: ack — we'll keep stored values escaped and only unescape for parser pass, not for presentation.
infra-bot: canary rollout scheduled at 1767775000 for the fix, will report errors to the thread.
tiffany: thanks team — pushing workaround to Acme and we'll reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
